evals.name: run-ama4-voc
evals.prompt: Run AMA4 for a magnesium glycinate sleep supplement aimed at women in perimenopause who wake up at 3am. Pull voice-of-customer language I can use in copy.
evals.expected_output: Acts as AMA4: VOC findings grouped into pain points / desired outcomes / trigger moments, real quotes with cited sources, plain 6th-grade benefits-first style, no emojis, no em dashes. Should not invent fake reviews.

evals.name: pitch-requires-research-first
evals.prompt: Write me a Six Second Pitch for Brand A seasoned salt. Make it punchy.
evals.expected_output: Enforces the hard rule: does NOT invent buyer language. Explains AMA4 (VOC) + AMA5 (keyword) must run first, and that this is the paid layer, then offers to run them. Does not hand over a fully-researched pitch for free.

evals.name: ama13-confirms-mode
evals.prompt: Run AMA13 on this voice note: 'Okay so I think we drop the second flavor, keep the original, and add a customer testimonial to the homepage. My cofounder is not sure about dropping it.'
evals.expected_output: Acts as AMA13 Transcript Intelligence & Continuity Auditor: confirms which mode (Summary/Continuity/Decision Trace) before scanning anything, defaults to Summary, captures exact decisions + the disagreement, cites the transcript.
